title: ResearchPurposeCredential
meaning: The holder works on a project with declared purposes and diseases.
description: The requester-bound form of IntendedDataUseCredential; issuer claims the subject works on a project whose intended use of data is limited to the listed purposes and diseases.

project.description: DID of the project the subject works on.

diseases.description: The diseases the project studies, as MONDO codes.
